s: Seder hallel kol yeme hechag ubo seip echad: achar shechazar sheliach tzibbur tepillat hashshachar — notelin hallulab uminayv leqayyem mitzvat aseh shel tora, shenneemar "uleqachtem lakem bayyom harishon vego'", umebarekin "al netilat lulab" ve"shehecheyanu". Veseder netilato ubirkotayv veninuo — yitbaer besiman trn"a. Umitzvat aseh middibre soperim ligmor hahallel kol shemonat yeme hechag, lepi shekkol yom vayom nechshab leyom tob bipne atzmo, kevan shechaluq beqorbenotayv mishshear yamim, mah sheen ken bepesach shekkol qorbanot shel kol hayyamim hen shavin, lepikak lo tiqqenu ligmor hahallel ella beyom rishon bilbad. Vekol mishpat hahallel vehilkotayv veyamim sheggomerin oto — kebar nitbaer besiman tp"ch, ayyen sham ubesiman tak"[b]. Veen omerim "el na leolam tooratz" bappiyyutim shel yom rishon shel sukkot:
